== Printed Unlimited publication ==
The complete white-border face prints 1 Force to deploy and 2 Force to use, matching this article’s game text.<ref>[[File:Premiere-U-L-electrobinoculars.jpg|Complete physical Unlimited face]].</ref> The Collecting Encyclopedia’s Unlimited entry identifies Electrobinoculars’ corrected cost placement among that edition’s revisions. Released uses the 1996 publication year supported by that entry and Decipher’s product collection; a month is not asserted.<ref name="premiere-unlimited-publication-year">Decipher, [https://web.archive.org/web/19990504174938id_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Star Wars CCG: The Expansions], Premiere Unlimited expansion and starter decks, 1996. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=35 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia], rev.3.2, PDF page35, Premiere Unlimited / White Border, 1996.</ref> The title follows the printed face, and the note records both the printed wording and its agreement with the later Glossary entry. Game text, lore, card UID, image and other card fields are unchanged.
